items.stem: In Agentforce, what is the role of a 'topic'?

options.text: It groups related instructions and actions the agent can use for a job to be done
options.rationale: Correct: a topic organises instructions and actions for a category of work.

options.text: It is the physical server the agent runs on
It replaces the need for any actions
options.rationale: Topics reference actions; they do not remove the need for them.

items.explanation: Correct: a topic organises instructions and actions for a category of work.

items.stem: Why ground an Agentforce agent in Data Cloud or knowledge data?

options.text: To base responses on trusted company data and reduce hallucination
options.rationale: Correct: grounding anchors responses in trusted, retrievable company data.

options.text: To make the agent respond more slowly
options.rationale: Grounding is about accuracy, not slowing responses.

options.text: To remove the need for testing

items.explanation: Correct: grounding anchors responses in trusted, retrievable company data.

items.stem: Select TWO steps that belong in responsibly deploying an Agentforce agent.

options.text: Run a test set in Testing Center before go-live
options.rationale: Correct: testing before deployment is a required step.

options.text: Deploy directly to production untested to save time

options.rationale: Correct: post-launch monitoring supports tuning and safety.

options.text: Remove all escalation paths to humans
Ground the agent on ungoverned data

items.explanation: Correct: testing before deployment is a required step.
